derivation.onset: Documentation-derived onset is Day +3 (ICE 8, Grade 1; section 6.2). The record's Day +5 is later than the documented onset: the 'earlier than first finding' condition does not apply, so 7.1 with difference +2 (record minus documents; section 7.1, A4).
derivation.max_grade: ICE 5/10 in an awake patient is Grade 2, equal to the record's 2, so 7.7. The Day +35 clinic note (ICE 10, tremor) is outside the Day 0-28 window and not used (section 6.5, A32); it would not change the grade anyway.

ambiguity_notes: Flag 'outside observation window' lists the Day +35 visit (D04). Chronic kidney disease and hypothyroidism are baseline and not on the A35 competing-cause list. No ambiguity in category.
